WHO SAYS SMOCKING IS JUST FOR BABY DRESSES?

Did you know we can bring those beautiful hand-smocked details to so much more than children's clothing?

Just look at these adorable custom blankets and bags we made for one of our lovely clients! Seeing her sweet feedback made our day!

At K-Embroidery, we love helping boutique owners explore new product ideas, from classic smocked dresses to personalized accessories that make their brand stand out.

Whether you're thinking of adding matching bags, blankets, or something completely different to your next collection, we're always happy to explore what's possible with you!

Have a fun idea you've been wanting to try for your brand? Send it our way! We'd love to help bring it to life

Direct me via WA: +84 83 333 3061

For boutique owners, we offer:
• FREE 2D mock-up design service with diverse design options
• 100% hand smocking & hand embroidery by Vietnamese artisans
• Direct production from our factory
• Low MOQs & flexible for your first order
• Sample development & bulk production
• Worldwide shipping via FedEx/UPS
